title: Turn home visuals into lived-in story evidence
starting_state: A home/interior carousel visual plan repeatedly says cozy home, warm room, plants, and couple moment.
It lacks motivated light, camera position, blocking, object continuity, tactile surfaces, and home-as-story evidence.
done_when: Home/interior visual planning requires a home-cinematic pass.
Each relevant slide names camera position, motivated light, blocking, object constellation, active movement, texture, negative space, and continuity callback.
Generic cozy-home filler blocks visual approval.
forbidden_changes: Do not treat random plants, chai, books, or beige rooms as story proof.
Do not weaken the existing visual-variety shot ladder.
Do not make the aesthetic a generic Pinterest/interior-design checklist.
fail_to_pass: generic cozy-home visual plans are rejected unless they provide cinematic story evidence fields
pass_to_pass: non-home carousels still use the normal shot ladder without being forced into domestic props
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should replace 'home' with apartment, kitchen, vanity, doorway, or living room and require concrete fields, not the exact phrase home-cinematic.
